verdict.rationale: Graphite's own CLI acts on several items at once within a stack. `gt absorb` amends staged hunks into the relevant commits across the stack, with a dry-run option, and `gt sync`/`gt get` can auto-delete merged or closed branches. A long-time user credits the CLI with rebasing multiple branches at once, and the merge queue lands stacked PRs in order. At org level, AI reviews can be enabled across all repositories in one step. These operations are all scoped to stacks or one-time setup rather than a general bulk-action capability. Missing for 10: arbitrary multi-select bulk actions across PRs or repos, bulk operations exposed for agents or scripting (e.g. via API or MCP), and in-depth docs on bulk workflows.
